translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: Rom
book.title: ROM Pol Rom Biynimb Kuyip Minj Tikak.

content: Pol “nimb Mindpim?” Aŋgak
Pen ay chin Piybiy, Senkriya biynimb kuyip Gor minim tep aŋgñimb ak, jap. Nimb mindpim ak amjakek, nup direp yimb ginimimb.
Yip tep giniŋgamb ak, nimb Biyomb chin anup gosimb niŋbim rek, nup direp giy, tap gunap ma mindek niŋiy monmon ñinimimb. Nuk biynimb okok kuyip direp giy, yip direp giy gip.
Pen Akiwiyla yip, biynuk Priysiyla yip Krays nup woŋg jimñiy giyiŋgipun biber ak kuyip aŋgnimimb, “Pol nirip ‘Mindpiyr?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb.”

Nind yip pikayniŋg geyak, biber tep yand kun ak mindiy, kasin girik. Pen chirup pikayniŋgiy aŋgiy gos ak ma niŋiy kun gerik, yip tep giy, Gor biynimb miñmon paryomb okok aŋgñen niŋbay gok kuyip tep giy gip.

Pen Gor biynimb nuk ap korip kuyipber ak nan-giy, lotiw gipay gok kunep aŋgnimimb, “Pol nimbip ‘Mindpim?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb.” Mam tep yand Epiyniytas nup aŋgnimimb, “Pol nip ‘Mindpan?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb.” Esiya propens, Krays nup nind dak, mey bi kun ak.
Biyn Mariya nimbip kosyam kond mindyiŋgip ak nup aŋgnimimb, “Pol nip, ‘Mindpan?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb,”

Pen bi lek lek yand niŋep rek, Androniykas yip, Jiwniyas yip, kuyipmiŋay aŋgnimimb, “Pol niripmiŋay, ‘Mindpiyr?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb.” Kiymiŋay mey Krays nup nind der, yand kisen dinik. Yip kalambis ayak rek, kuyipmiŋay kunep kalambis ayey, jimñiy mindyiŋgipun. Pen bi Jiysis minim dand amemb gok, bi omiŋal kun ak kuyip niŋrep yimb gipay.
Mam tep yand Ambliyetas, Krays nup chiŋg tep gip ak, nup aŋgnimimb, “Pol aŋgip, ‘Mindpan?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb.”
Mam Ebanas nup aŋgnimimb, “Pol nip, ‘Mindpan?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb.” Mam kun ak chirmiŋay Krays nup woŋg ak jimñiy gipur. Mam tep Stekiys nup kunep aŋgnimimb, “Pol nip ‘Mindpan?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb.”
Apeliys, Krays nup gosimb nokom niŋimb ak nup aŋgnimimb, “Pol nip, ‘Mindpan?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb.” Biynimb Ariystobyiwlas korip ak mindpay gok kuyip aŋgnimimb, “Pol nimbip ‘Mindpim?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb.”

Bi lek lek yand niŋep rek, Herodiyon nup aŋgnimimb, “Pol nip, ‘Mindpan?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb.” Biynimb Nasiysas korip ak mindiy, Krays ker mindpay gok kuyip aŋgnimimb, “Pol nimbip ‘Mindpim?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb.”

Biyn Triypana yip Triyposa yip, Biyomb chin anup gosimb niŋyiŋg woŋg gipiyr omiŋal ak kuyip aŋgnimimb, “Pol niripmiŋay, ‘Mindpiyr?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb.” Ay tep Pesis, Biyomb chin ak nup gosimb niŋyiŋg woŋg gip anup kunep, aŋgnimimb “Pol nip, ‘Mindpan?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb.”
Bi Riwpas, Krays ker mindip ak nup aŋgnimimb, “Pol nip ‘Mindpan?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb.” Nonim nup ak, amiy yand rek ayek “Amiy” apiyn ak nup kunep aŋgnimimb, “Pol nip ‘Mindpan?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb.”
Asinkriytas, Pliygon, Hemis, Patrobas, Hemas, numam kiy yip mindpay gok, kuyip maŋgiysek aŋgnimimb, “Pol nimbip, ‘Mindpim?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb.”
Piylologas biynuk Jiwliya yip, Nereyas nunay nuk Olyimpas yip, biynimb Gor ker mindiy kiy yip mindpay gok sek kunep aŋgnimimb, “Pol, nimbip. ‘Mindpim?’ aŋgip aŋgnimimb.”
Gor nup gosimb niŋbim rek, penpen wasiw giyiŋg, ñin piksaknimimb. Krays biynimb nuk akniy keykey nan-gipay rek, nimbip “mindpim?” apay.
Minim Yesek Gok Ma Dinimimb

Mam ay sikop. Niŋrep ginimimb. Biynimb gunap minim okok nimb dand apiy, biynimb Krays ker mindpay gok kuyip aŋgñey, gos tep nind niŋyak ar ak kirgiy, gos ñimbay kun ak diy, asik keykey aypay. Kun ak nimbip kunep ginimuŋ rek ayip ak, minim aŋgniŋgiy ak ma dinimimb.

Biynimb kun gipay gok, Biyomb chin Krays nup woŋg ak gun aŋgiy ma gipay; kuyip key tep gip ar anep niŋiy gipay. Kiyk minim sayn biynimb yimb dand aranemb anep aŋgiy, biynimb niŋrep ma gipay gok kuyip gos timey ar kun ak ñimbay.
Nimb pen, Gor minim tep ak direp gem, biynimb okok maŋgiysek niŋbay ak, yip tep yimb gip. Pen biynimb gunap minim monmon aŋgniŋgiy ak, ma yimb dinimimb.
Maŋ mindip. Gor Biyomb biynimb kond mindip ak, Seytan nup di talak miŋgan nimbip okok ayek, kilis nuk ma mindeniŋgamb. Biyomb chin Jiysis ñin ar ak mindenimimb.
Ñi woŋg yand yip jimñiy gipur, Timotiy; nimbip “Mindpim?” asap. Bi yand Liwsiyas, Jeson, Sosiypata kunep nimbip, “Mindpim?” aspay.
Pen yand bi Taydiyas, Pol aŋgek minj tikpiyn biy, kunep nimb Rom kay Krays ker mindpim gok, “Mindpim?” aspiyn.

Bi Gayas, yip dam korip nuk ak ay, kond mindrep gip ak, nimbip “Mindpim?” asap. Bi kun anep Krays ker mindpay biynimb gok aŋgek, korip nup ak apey girep gip. Pen bi kus kus pey ñemb Erastas yip, mam chin Kiwotas yip kunep nimbip, ‘Mindpim?’ aspiyr.
[Nimb maŋgiysek Biyomb chin Jiysis Krays biynimb simb niŋimb ak ñin ar nup ak mindenimimb. Tep.]

Pen Gor nup yimb ak dand aranjun. Nuk nep mey nimbip kond mindakniŋ, nup chiŋgrep giy mindeniŋgambim. Jiysis minim tep kun ak nind weygiy mindyiŋgip; pen miñiy bi Gor minim aŋgep gok minim nup tikyak ak miseŋ gamb, minim tep kun ak biynimb okok kuyip per aŋgñimbiyn. Gor nep aŋgek mey, biynimb miñmon okok maŋgiysek aŋgon, nup gosimb niŋiy aŋgip rek gipay.
Gor bi gos tipaŋgiy niŋimb ak, chinup aŋgiy Jiysis Krays nup yokak rek, yimb nup ak perper nep dand aranemb. Tep.
